NGA.note: Verification of identity is only a hoped-for aim; no authentication service is described.
Nothing on a link with the civil register.
A count of 117 million NINs is given but the document states no population or share to compare it with.
Nothing on a number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Passport renewal needing a NIN is not a register keyed on the number.

facts.fact: BusinessDay, citing NIMC data, reports total NIN enrolments reached 117 million by 28 February 2025, up from 96.5 million in February 2023, in a database holding demographic data, fingerprints and facial images.
